dataflow.description:
### Human actors
- Banking customers accessing account information
- System administrators managing account operations
- Database administrators maintaining PostgreSQL

### External entities
- Internet clients accessing API endpoints
- AWS CloudWatch for logging and monitoring
- AWS Cognito for user authentication services

### Processes
- API Gateway HTTP API routing requests
- Lambda banking API processing business logic
- RDS PostgreSQL database engine
- Cognito User Pool authentication
- CloudWatch Logs aggregation
- KMS encryption service

### Data stores

| Store | Type | High-Value (Y/N) |
|-------|------|------------------|
| RDS PostgreSQL banking database | Relational DB | Y |
| Cognito User Pool | Identity store | Y |
| CloudWatch Logs | Log storage | N |
| Lambda environment variables | Configuration | Y |
| Terraform state | Infrastructure state | N |

### Trust boundaries

| Zone | Elements | Trust Level |
|------|----------|-------------|
| Internet | External clients | Untrusted |
| AWS API Gateway | HTTP API, routing | Semi-trusted |
| AWS VPC Internal | Lambda, RDS, security groups | Trusted |
| AWS Managed Services | Cognito, CloudWatch, KMS | Trusted |

### Data flows

| Flow ID | Description | Source | Target | Trust Boundaries Crossed | Assets |
|---------|-------------|--------|--------|--------------------------|--------|
| F1 | Account info request | Internet client | API Gateway | Internet to AWS | Account data |
| F2 | Lambda invocation | API Gateway | Lambda function | Gateway to VPC | Request data |
| F3 | Database query | Lambda | RDS PostgreSQL | None | Account/transaction data |
| F4 | Authentication check | Lambda | Cognito User Pool | VPC to AWS managed | User credentials |
| F5 | Transaction history request | Internet client | API Gateway | Internet to AWS | Transaction data |
| F6 | Admin freeze operation | Admin client | API Gateway | Internet to AWS | Admin commands |
| F7 | Log data transmission | Lambda | CloudWatch Logs | VPC to AWS managed | Application logs |
| F8 | Database response | RDS PostgreSQL | Lambda | None | Banking data |
| F9 | API response | Lambda | API Gateway | VPC to Gateway | Response data |
| F10 | Final response | API Gateway | Internet client | AWS to Internet | Account/transaction data |

assumptions.content: Lambda function implements banking business logic for account and transaction operations

metadata.value: Based on API endpoints and database configuration, assuming standard banking operations in Lambda code

assumptions.content: Database contains accounts table and transactions table based on API endpoint patterns

metadata.value: API routes suggest /accounts/{id} and /accounts/{id}/transactions endpoints require corresponding data structures

assumptions.content: Authentication flow uses Cognito User Pool for user verification before API access

metadata.value: Cognito User Pool configured with password policies suggests authentication integration with API

assumptions.content: Admin operations require elevated privileges for account management functions

metadata.value: POST /admin/freeze-account endpoint suggests role-based access control for administrative functions

assumptions.content: Database credentials flow from Terraform variables to Lambda environment variables

metadata.value: Lambda configuration shows DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD environment variables from Terraform
